邯郸学步Hándān xuébù 53/5/7/100 Imitating the gait of Handan residents
Text Chinese + English 

有个人到邯郸城去玩，看见那里的人走路的姿势特别好看。
A man went to the city of Handan for a visit and noticed that the locals had a particularly graceful way of walking. 
他就跟在邯郸人的身后，模仿人家走路的样子。
He began to follow them and imitate their walking style. 
但是，这种走路的姿势也真不好学，这个人累得满头大汗，也没有学会。
However, this way of walking turned out to be very difficult to learn. The man ended up drenched in sweat but still could not master it.
“太难了，不学了！我该回家了。“
“It’s too difficult, I won’t learn it anymore! I should go home.”
糟糕的事情发生了——这个人没有学会邯郸人走路的样子，反而把自己原来走路的样子也忘记了！
Something unfortunate happened: not only did he fail to learn how the people of Handan walked, but he also forgot how he used to walk himself. 
没办法，他只好爬着回家。
Having no other option, he had to crawl all the way back home.

含义：比喻模仿别人不到家，把自己本来有的东西丢掉了。
Meaning: A metaphor for the idea that blindly imitating others can lead to losing one’s own abilities and strengths.
智慧启迪：学习要从自己的实际出发，不能生搬硬套。
Lesson: Learning should be based on one’s own practical reality and abilities, rather than mechanical imitation without understanding.
